scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-secrets.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.verify: npm run security:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run security:check
scripts.demo:reset: tsx scripts/clean-showcase-storage.ts && npx supabase db query --linked --file scripts/sql/reset-demo-data.sql && npm run demo:bootstrap
scripts.automation:setup: npm run graphify:install && npm run prepare
scripts.graphify:install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && .venv/bin/graphify install --project --platform codex
scripts.supabase:types: mkdir -p backend/src/lib && supabase gen types --lang typescript --linked --schema public > backend/src/lib/database.types.ts
